11367.overview:
An official licensed game of the European Championships held in England in 1996. All 16 teams are available to choose from and the following Game Types: European Championship, Friendly Game, Practice Penalties and Practice Match (only the opposition's goalkeeper is on the pitch). 

A couple of options of note are variable/adjustable wind and a choice of referees each with two difficulty levels of 'vision' and 'discipline' (the latter is available for friendly games only). Long time BBC sport commentator Barry Davies provides the commentary. The game is based on Gremlin Interactive's Actua Soccer engine.

11368.overview:
Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 combines the best of all the Mortal Kombats into a single disc. 23 playable characters are immediately available, such as Reptile, Cyrax, Scorpion, Sub-Zero, Jax, Katana, Sonya, and more. There are two bosses that are unlockable, as well as additional characters.

There is a variety of new levels, some of which are interactive. Characters can uppercut someone, causing them to hit the ground hard and crash through to the bottom floor, or they can knocked someone off a bridge, landing in a pit of spikes.

Players can go against the computer one-on-one, two-on-two, or take part in the 8-fighter tournament.

141459.overview: Ultraman: Hikari no Kyojin Densetsu is a 1-on-1 fighting game based on the Ultraman series of TV shows. The game features pre-rendered character graphics in fully-3D environments, though it plays strictly on a 2D plane. There are a total of 15 characters available — 5 Ultra Heroes and 10 kaiju monsters — and two main game modes: Ultra Mode is the main story mode where the player selects one of the heroes and attempts to defeat all of the monsters, while the VS modes let one or two players freely battle using any of the characters. Unlike some previous Ultraman games, the player does not need to defeat monsters with the same special move as in the original TV show, though doing so will grant bonus points.

141461.overview: Uno DX is a digital adaptation of the popular multiplayer card game Uno. The main attraction is the Advanced Uno story mode, which features a cast of bombastic anime characters and is set in a Japanese high school. This mode follows the protagonist Shunichi and is structured like an adventure game, with the player visiting various locations around the school, meeting the other characters and witnessing various events, and of course playing rounds of Uno against up to five other characters to settle their differences. Also included is a standard quick play mode of the card game for one or two players, with 11 different characters available to play as or against.

175216.overview: Kurubushi Kyōdai Gekijō Dai-ikkan: Mahjong-hen ("Ankle Brothers Theater Volume 1: Mahjong Edition") is a 4-player reach mahjong game featuring a cast of bizarre cartoon characters. The main story mode has the player complete a series of matches against randomly-selected opponents; each of the playable characters has their own story campaign with several chapters, all of which are suitably strange and told via still illustrations. There is also a free battle mode where the player can set up a match with any of the eight characters and customize the game rules.

176091.overview:
Ultraman Zukan (ウルトラマン図鑑) is a Sega Saturn title released in 1996. It not a "game" per se, but rather software explaining the details of Ultraman and Ultra Seven.

It was followed by Ultraman Zukan 2 and Ultraman Zukan 3.

176100.overview: Ultraman Zukan 2 (ウルトラマン図鑑２) is a Sega Saturn sequel to Ultraman Zukan. It is a database of Ultraman Jack, Ultraman Ace and Ultraman Taro.

176102.overview: Ultraman Zukan 3 (ウルトラマン図鑑３) is a sequel to Ultraman Zukan 2. It is a database of Ultraman Leo, Ultraman 80 and other Ultra Series.

176103.overview: Umanari 1 Furlong Gekijou is a cartoon-style race horse breeding & management simulation game based on a manga by Miho Yoshida, one of several produced by Micro Vision. The player can breed horses and hire jockeys, determine training schedules, and enter their horses into races; races are computer-controlled but can be watched by the player with a running commentary. The game features a cartoony visual style, and a particularly unique feature is the ability to directly speak with the horses; as cartoon characters, they are able to talk, which lets the player ask them directly about their condition.

176104.overview: Universal Nuts is a sci-fi visual novel featuring two protagonists, Yui and Ai, which get involved in an incident onboard a space station. As the story progresses, the mystery of events that have occurred start to unfold. The game plays in a typical visual novel style by reading through on-screen text and dialogues to progress the story. Character icons are present during dialogues beside the character art over the background image, and the game features both animated cut-scenes and voice-acting.

176105.overview:
The Unsolved is an adventure game in style of The X Files that uses real-actors and real photo backdrops. The player assumes a role of a police detective who is trying to solve the series of murders in downtown Los Angeles, where all the victims are women. All the victims seem to be missing organs and depleted of their blood, and modus operandi of the perpetrator is unknown. Police is tapping in the dark, and the closer you get to the truth, the story mixes science fiction and supernatural, much like The X Files.

While actors use English, this game is not released outside of Japan, and subtitles as well as any other in-game text are in Japanese.
